title: Spoilit
pitch: Hide Reddit posts and comments about the movie, show or game you haven't caught up on, without muting whole communities.
description: Type a title and Spoilit gathers its characters, cast and episodes from Wikidata and fan wikis, then covers matching posts and whole comment sections. Matching runs in your browser; a Claude key is optional for new releases.

externals.name: Reddit
externals.seam: --host-resolver-rules maps www.reddit.com to a local server (demo/serve.mjs); the hosted build serves the same page itself
externals.note: A synthetic feed of invented posts and comments in Reddit's markup. It is not Reddit, and the real site's markup can change.

externals.name: Wikidata and Fandom lookups
externals.seam: the topic's saved terms in chrome.storage.local, seeded by demo/seed.mjs
externals.note: House of the Dragon and Elden Ring come with hand-written sample terms. Looking up a new title needs the installed extension.

externals.name: Chrome extension APIs
externals.seam: window.chrome, defined on the hosted page before the extension scripts run (demo/web/build.mjs)
externals.note: chrome.storage.local is kept in localStorage; the strip above the feed stands in for the toolbar popup. The local demo loads the real extension instead.

externals.name: Claude API key
externals.seam: the optional API key in Settings; sources.js skips Claude when none is set
externals.note: Only used when you add a key. The demo does not call it.
